Messages.Author: Pascek
Messages.Body:
Hello Pascal,

Can you please tell me where can I find the ruling that states that a player that plays Villein on a vampire with 1 or 0 blood needs to take all the blood from it?

I am trying to find but no success.

Thank you,

Roberto Mautone Jr.
Praetor

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: You don't need any ruling for that, its all in villeins card text. You must take at least 2 blood with villein, if the vampire has less than that, you still need to try to take 2, which obviously results in taking all it has. Same as if you do an action that you cannot afford to pay at the resolution anymore, you still have to use all the blood the vampire has to try to pay the cost of the action.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
[LSJ 20090316]

> LSJ wrote:
> Jozxyqk wrote:
> > If I have a vampire with only 1 blood, can I play Villein on him,
> > and take just that 1 blood?
> >
> > "Put this card on a vampire you control and move 2 or more blood
> > from that vampire to your pool..."
> >
> > The reason I ask is I remember LSJ ruling that if Menele had only
> > 1 blood, he could still use his ability with 1 blood, just like
> > Drain Essence can still be played against a vampire with 1 blood and
> > steal 1, etc.
> Yes.
>
For zero blood, see also:  [LSJ 20081126]
>
> LSJ wrote:
> Tetragrammaton wrote:
> > In order to play the card, the target vampire *must* have
> > at least two blood to be taken off, or Villein can also be played on a
> > vampire with one or zero blood ?
> The latter.
>
This is also derived from  RTR 11-JUL-01 :

> RTR wrote:
> Q: Can I play Cryptic Mission against a vampire with no blood? How about
> Blood to Water against a vampire with only 2 blood?
> A: Yes. Steal/burn blood/life effects target the minion, not the individual
> blood counters. Similarly, burn pool effects target the Methuselah, not
> the individual pool counters.
>
In general, things affecting counters target the thing they're on, and affect as many counters as exist up to the stated amount, and you're allowed to announce the effect even if there are less than the stated amount (unless card text specifies something else, I guess).
